**Final stock of SKU-42: 12 units**

**Restocks: 2** (one of 12 units and one of 6 units)

SKU-42 starts at 10 units, and the log records these changes in order:

| Step | Event | Change | Running stock |
|---|---|---|---|
| Start | Starting stock | — | 10 |
| 1 | Sold 4 | −4 | 6 |
| 2 | Restocked 12 | +12 | 18 |
| 3 | Sold 9 | −9 | 9 |
| 4 | Restocked 6 | +6 | 15 |
| 5 | Sold 3 | −3 | **12** |

The entry numbers restart within each block, so I've treated the SKU-42 events in the order they appear in the log.
